name: mteb-loc-bench-reranking
description: A subset of the MTEB (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark) focused on reranking tasks that measures how well embedding- or retrieval-based systems reorder candidate documents given a query. It evaluates retrieval quality by comparing model-produced ranked lists against ground-truth relevance judgments across diverse text domains. The benchmark is used to compare ranking effectiveness of embedding models and rerankers.
evaluation_method: NDCG@10 (ranking metrics such as MRR and Recall@k are commonly reported)
reputation: Part of the MTEB family and recognized within the embedding/retrieval research community as a standard reranking evaluation.
